## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any permission or settings migration.

## Validation

List relevant automated checks and physical-device results. Name the device, ROM and Android version. Do not treat emulator tests as proof of SystemUI compatibility.

## Review

- [ ] No private captures, notification identifiers, credentials or signing files
- [ ] Relevant limitations, licenses and notices updated
- [ ] Existing app ID, component grants and configured settings preserved
